title: Level 5's Holy Horror Mansion Game's Trailer Reveals 2027 Release for Switch 2, PS5, PC
content:
Level 5 unveiled during the Level 5 Vision 2026 II Dream livestream on Thursday its new "ghost craft" role-playing game HOLY HORROR MANSION , and it announces that the game will launch in 2027 for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam . The video and footage from the stream preview gameplay, characters, and story:

The company will announce more at a cross-media presentation.

The story follows Ten Lordland (О̄ya in Japanese), who lives in a mansion on top of an apartment complex. After finding a weird camera within a locked room, his nose hair starts glowing, and a ghost pops out of his nose. With the powers of different ghosts, Ten aims to stop the evil De Ville Corp, its Darkarymen, and its weird monster-items. Using Cameron, the ghost camera, players can find hidden ghosts.

Level 5 is partnering with entertainment companies for the game, which is themed around "family." The company revealed it as a new concept for its Yōkai Watch franchise and called it its "largest cross-media project to date." The RPG features ghostly mechanics that are based on real-life performers.

A previous video had revealed three different ghosts and their movement inspirations. The green ghost is inspired by real-life performer SANTA, who is a member of WARPs UP . When the green ghost enters anything, the object comes to life. The blue ghost's movement is based on Japanese comedian and singer-songwriter Pikotarō . The blue ghost can combine objects such as apples and pens to create chimeras. The pink ghost's movement is based on Japanese dance team avantgardey , who has previously appeared on the America's Got Talent show. The pink ghost is like an architect who can create worlds.

Level 5 announced the Yōkai Watch franchise in 2011 with a game, manga, and anime already planned. The franchise 's first game for the Nintendo 3DS debuted in Japan in July 2013, and the original anime premiered in January 2014.

Yōkai Watch 2: Haunted Domain , a new updated version of the Yōkai Watch 2 Nintendo 3DS game, is launching for Nintendo Switch, PS5, and PC via Steam .

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms Release Schedule Ahead of October Debut – Watch New Trailer
content:
Avatar: The Last Airbender is coming back this Fall with the next major step of the story, and Avatar: Seven Havens has confirmed its episode release schedule ahead of its Paramount+ premiere with a new trailer showing it all off. Avatar Studios has made its return to screens this year with a brand new feature film, Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender , but that’s not all that’s coming our way. Now we’re about to see what’s coming next after The Legend of Korra with a brand new TV series and a new Avatar to follow .

Avatar: Seven Havens will be officially making its debut with Paramount+ this October, and it follows the next Avatar after Korra. Set in a world that has suffered a major cataclysm years after the events of The Legend of Korra , Pavi is a new Avatar who needs to make her way through a new era where people don’t really revere the Avatar in the way they used to. You can check out the new trailer for Avatar: Seven Havens below.

When Does Avatar: Seven Havens Come Out?

Avatar: Seven Havens will be officially making its debut with Paramount+ on October 9th with its first three episodes. Episodes 4-6 will then be released a few days later with the streaming service on October 16th, Episode 7-9 will then follow on October 23rd, and then the final Episodes 10-13 will be wrapping up the first season on October 30th. So for those fans worried that all of the episodes from the new series would be dropping at once, this new release schedule confirms that it won’t be an issue with time in between to absorb all of the events.

Avatar: Seven Havens has been confirmed to be 26 episodes in total, and will be spread across two seasons. Book 1 of the series will be releasing with Paramount+ through October, and release details for Book 2 will be revealed at a later date. With this new series sparking a major mystery through its central story, it’s good to see that there won’t really be an issue with its release schedule. It’s not exactly going to be weekly as many fans might have wanted, but it’s certainly much better than an entire season releasing within a single day . There will be opportunities for it to build a community this way.

What Is Avatar: Seven Havens About?

Avatar: Seven Havens is set about 225 years after the events of The Legend of Korra , and that already raises a lot of questions as to what to expect from the series. It’s either that Korra herself lived for hundreds of years before her passing, or the Avatar chain didn’t continue until that long after. Either way, the series introduces fans to a young Earthbender named Pavi who has grown up in a ruined world and is in search of her long lost twin sister. With spirits and humans on the hunt, Pavi has a lot to keep an eye out for.

Original franchise creators Michael DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko have returned to oversee Avatar: Seven Havens as part of Avatar Studios, and it’s the next phase in this long running story. If it ends up being a success, the creators have already teased that they are working on a potential new TV project with the studio next that could take more of a shape in the future .

title: Death Note Stage Musical Will Return To London's Barbican Centre in 2027
content:
The musical's current six-week run at the Barbican will end on this coming Saturday, September 12. As of writing, there are a few tickets left on Thursday.

The musical also has a page at the Barbican website, where the tickets are also linked.

Death Note The Musical is described on the musical's website:

"With over 30 million copies sold worldwide, this 'triumphant, fantastical manga thriller' ( WhatsOnStage ) by Tsugumi Ohba and Takeshi Obata is a global sensation that has captivated audiences worldwide.

"Now, boldly reimagined for the London stage, this 'highly entertaining musical' ( The Times ) features an 'electrifying, symphonic and catchy' ( BroadwayWorld ) score by Tony, Grammy and Emmy nominee Frank Wildhorn, lyrics by Jack Murphy and a book by Ivan Menchell.

"When brilliant student Light Yagami discovers a notebook with the power to determine who lives and who dies, his mission to reshape society quickly spirals out of control and attracts the attention of the elusive and ruthless detective L. What begins as justice descends into obsession and forces both to confront the limits of morality itself.

"The musical is performed in English. It runs for two and a half hours, including a 20-minute interval, and has an age guidance rating of 12+."

Frank Wildhorn has also written stage musical versions of Your Lie in April and Fist of the North Star . His Your Lie in April musical ran in The Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End from July to September 2024. Wildhorn is an American composer, who also wrote songs sung by Whitney Houston ("Where Do Broken Hearts Go?") and Natalie Cole, and many other stage musicals.

In Tsugumi Ohba and Takeshi Obata 's original 2003-2006 supernatural suspense manga, teenager Light Yagami finds a notebook with which he can put people to death by writing their names. He begins a self-anointed crusade against the criminals of the world, and a cat-and-mouse game begins with the authorities and one idiosyncratic genius detective.
author: ANN

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Will Be Released in UK IMAX Cinemas From November 3
content:
Anime Limited has released a new trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki . The trailer confirms that the film will open in IMAX cinemas on November 3, and in general cinemas on November 6. (A previous teaser had given the release date as November 6.)

There will also be preview screenings at the London Film Festival. Tickets will be available to the general public from Thursday September 17 at 10 a.m, and from Thursday September 10 at 10 a.m. for BFI Members. The screenings will be on Wednesday October 14 (5.30 p.m.) at the BFI IMAX cinema (overlapping with the first Look Back screening above), and on Friday October 16 (5.30 p.m.) at the Prince Charles. The screening links are here .

The London Film Festival describes the film as follows:

"Japan, 1949. Pilot Kōichi, his wife Noriko and adoptive daughter Akiko are attempting from recover from Godzilla's recent attacks. But just as everything seems settled, a new danger emerges. Meanwhile, at the bottom of the sea, something is stirring. The first Japanese film to be shot for IMAX, Godzilla Minus Zero combines high-octane thrills with more than a little heart."

Yamazaki returned as director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor. Production was at TOHO Studios, with ROBOT producing the film and Shirogumi Inc. handling the visual effects.

title: Compile Heart's Villion:Code Game Heads West in 2027
content:
Idea Factory International announced on Thursday that it will release Villion:Code , developer Compile Heart 's new school RPG , in the West for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam in 2027. The PS5 version will have physical editions in North America and Europe, and the Switch and and PS4 versions will get physical editions in North America. The company streamed a trailer:

The game's story is set in the near future where humanity is facing its approaching destruction. To find a solution to this certain doom, the "Advan Resilience Research Academy City" is established. One day, an anomaly appears in the city, which spawns strange beings known as GEM that begin attacking people, and generates a "bubble" that cuts it off from any contact or travel in or out. In this new isolated state, people begin to confront their roles as they pursue the truth of the anomaly in the academy city.

FRAM performs the game's opening theme song "Rebirth Code" and the ending theme song "Echoes of Tomorrow."

Atlus co-founder and Shin Megami Tensei and Persona series co-creator Kōji Okada is the planning producer for the game. Tadashi Satomi, the scenario writer for the first two Persona games and The Caligula Effect , is the scenario writer for the game. Tsukasa Masuko — the sound composer for many of the early Shin Megami Tensei games as well as The Caligula Effect , Monark , and Varlet games — is credited as sound creator. Ilya Kuvshinov ( The Wonderland , Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 , Death Stranding Isolations ) is the character designer.

The game's tagline on the website reads "Kōji Okada's ultimate message to the next generation."

title: Straight Edge Launches Horizontal Manga Label
content:
Author agency and IP production company Straight Edge launched on Wednesday its own manga label called Straight Edge Comic (SEC), which will plan, edit, and publish manga in horizontal format. Additionally, STUDIO ZOON former editor-in-chief Kento Kaji will join Straight Edge as a manga editing adviser. Kaji will mainly establish a manga editing and production flow and forge partnerships with manga artists. Straight Edge founder and overall editor-in-chief Kazuma Miki will be in charge of producing the works and media mix strategies.

The new label is looking for original authors, manga artists, and freelance editors. With the motto "Creator First," the label will aim to nurture each project with a small, elite team, and for serialization to start in 2027.

The new label will also introduce a "sliding royalty" system, where the royalty rate increases as manga sales increase. It also guarantees a success-based compensation, where external or freelance editors will share the profits if a work becomes a hit.

With serialized works, the label will only accept works that pass the editorial meeting after preparing several chapters of storyboards, but assures that creators will still be paid the "planning and development costs" even if a work does not pass the meeting, in addition with working with creators to plan their next project.

The digital-first manga label also plans to distribute titles through major online stores, but will also aim to release hit works in printed volumes. The label's initial goal will be a title's anime adaptation by having one of Japan's largest advertising groups to collaborate on select titles to become a partner for promotion, marketing, and screen adaptation, and also deploy comprehensive promotional strategies to further nurture and grow the titles.

Miki left Kadokawa as Dengeki Bunko 's editor-in-chief in March 2016, and started Straight Edge in April the same year. The company's contracted writers include Kazuma Kamachi ( A Certain Magical Index , Heavy Object ), Reki Kawahara ( Sword Art Online , Accel World ), Tsutomu Satou ( The irregular at magic high school ), and Tsukasa Fushimi ( Oreimo , Eromanga Sensei ).

Miki joined the editorial department of Dengeki Bunko in 2001, when he worked on Shakugan no Shana , and became editor-in-chief in 2014. He served as editor on titles such as A Certain Magical Index , Sword Art Online , and The irregular at magic high school , and was also a producer on their respective anime adaptations. Kadokawa published his autobiographical book Omoshirokereba Nandemo Ari: Hakkō Ruikei 6,000-man-bu ― Toaru Henshū no Life Work (If It's Interesting It Can Be Anything: 60 Million Copies in Print ― A Certain Editor's Life Work).

title: Major HIDIVE Isekai Reveals New Look at Season 2 Return After 4 Years
content:
Ahead of its long-awaited return to the seasonal anime circuit, Reincarnated as a Sword just dropped a brand-new key visual of the series’ protagonists Fran and Teacher with a stunning updated design and a small sneak peek at what fans can expect when the anime begins airing in October 2026. Reincarnated as a Sword , as the title suggests, follows an individual from the real world after being transported to a fantasy world as they’re reborn as a sentient magic sword. While he retains most of his memories of being a human, Teacher is unable to move on his own, but quickly learns that he’s able to grow stronger by absorbing magic crystals that live inside of this new world’s monster population.

Eventually, a young cat girl named Fran comes across Teacher and the two begin adventuring together as Fran searches to overcome her tragic past and restore the honor of the Black Cat clan, something that Teacher is more than willing to help provide.

Despite Its 4 Year Hiatus, Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 Is an Exciting New Adventure

Reincarnated as a Sword stands out from other isekai series by having its protagonist exist as a sentient weapon. It isn’t played up as a gag to hinder the character in anyway, instead, Teacher’s character arc and continual growth throughout the series beautifully reflects Fran’s internal strength and development as the external driving force of the story. Season 1 ended in a relatively comfortable spot, with Fran and Teacher finishing the events of the Dungeon-Clearing arc and preparing to set out on a new adventure after a successful raid.

Season 2, which will be included in 2026’s seasonal anime lineup this fal l will be adapting the Floating Island arc and Speedrun arc from the original light novels, taking Fran and Teacher to a high-altitude environment where they’ll have to adapt their abilities to survive. While the official episode count for the new season hasn’t been revealed just yet, Season 1 of the anime had a 12-episode run, with this season likely following the same trajectory for pacing.

Where To Read & Watch Reincarnated as a Sword

For those looking to get caught up on Reincarnated as a Sword before Season 2 drops in October , the complete first season can be found on HIDIVE, with episodes also being available through Amazon Prime Video for users with a subscription to HIDIVE. For diehard fans of Fran and Teacher, Japan will be premiering the second season early, on September 30, 2026 through ABEMA. The standard release, and subsequent simulcast in the west will begin on October 7, 2026, releasing weekly on Wednesdays.

For fans interested in the original light novels by Yuu Tanaka, the series currently has 19-volumes available and is published in English by Seven Seas Entertainment, who handles the localization and publication of the light novel and manga adaptations for the series. The physical release can be found in retailers like Barnes & Noble, Books-a-Million, and Amazon.

title: Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain Game's Extended Trailer Reveals PS5, PC Releases
content:
Level 5 announced during the Level 5 Vision 2026 II Dream livestream that Yōkai Watch 2: Haunted Domain , a new updated version of the Yōkai Watch 2 Nintendo 3DS game, will launch on PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam in addition to the previously announced Nintendo Switch 2 version. The company streamed an extended version of the trailer that it debuted on Wednesday. The English-subtitled video shows Jibanyan, Whisper, and series' protagonist Nate (Keita in Japan). The trailer then previews gameplay and more Yo-kai, set to the series' theme song "Geragerapō no Uta" originally performed by King Cream Soda .

The company teased new Yo-kai for the game.

Yōkai Watch 1 for Switch , a Nintendo Switch port of the original Yōkai Watch Nintendo 3DS game, debuted in Japan in October 2019. The game is a remaster with HD graphics. The game did not get a release in the West.

The Yōkai Watch 2: Bony Spirits and Yōkai Watch 2: Fleshy Souls games launched for 3DS in Japan in July 2014, in North America in September 2016, and in Europe in April 2017. The Yōkai Watch 2: Psychic Specters game then shipped in Japan in December 2014 and in North America and Europe in September 2017.

title: BanG Dream! Releases Yumemita x Our Notes Story Trailer
content:
A story link trailer for BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA has been released, announcing that the story of the TV anime will continue in the upcoming game BanG Dream! Our Notes . A band visual was also released. The game also previously released an introduction trailer for the band.

A band visual was also released featuring the outfits the members wore in the final episode’s live performance:

NICHICALINE animated the first season with Tomomi Umezu as the director and Hiroshi Morita as the assistant director. Midori Goto was in charge of the series composition, while Osamu Nobusawa and Mochipuyo were in charge of character design. Crunchyroll and Muse Asia are streaming the series. The cast includes:

• Arale Nakamachi (vocals)

• Nonoka Miyanaga (lead guitar)

• Ritsu Minetsuki (rhythm guitar)

• Miyako Fuji (keyboard)

• Yuno Sengoku (DJ)

• Kaede Hondo as Viola

• Wakana Maruoka as Bell

• Yui Tsukada as Popo

• Runa Sanai as Manager

• Maaya Uchida as Koharu

• Konomi Kohara as Kaede

• Miho Okasaki as Yuina

BanG Dream! Our Notes weaves an all-new multi-route narrative across five distinct girl bands and a cast of 25 characters. Returning fan favorites MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica are joined by Mugendai MewType, millsage, and Ikka Dumb Rock!, each with their own dedicated story chapters. In this brand-new mobile game released under the BanG Dream! project, the story begins with the chapters of MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica, and gradually unfolds into a narrative woven by five girls’ bands. The game features narratives that portray the choices and growth of the girls’ bands both on stage and in their lives, combined with diverse gameplay mechanics to deliver a brand-new experience centered on youth and bonds—further expanding the BanG Dream! project’s expression in gaming.

To further elevate the storytelling experience, the game introduces its Cinematic Narrative System, bringing emotional moments to life through expressive character animation, dynamic performance sequences, richly illustrated story scenes, and storyboard-inspired cinematic cutscenes.

Players can revisit memorable moments from the MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica anime from a game-exclusive perspective while discovering brand-new stories that continue beyond the animated series. Meanwhile, Mugendai MewType, millsage, and Ikka Dumb Rock! each make their narrative debut with original story chapters exploring their unique personalities, relationships, and musical journeys. Source: BanG Dream! Our Notes Official X (formerly Twitter) ©BDP ©FTK ©BUSHI ©BHK

title: Professor Layton and the Curious Village Game Gets Remake
content:
Level 5 announced during the Level 5 Vision 2026 livestream on Thursday that its Professor Layton and the Curious Village ( Layton Kyōju to Fushigi na Machi ) game is getting a remake for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in 2027. The company streamed a trailer:

Level 5 also streamed a new trailer for its Professor Layton and The New World of Steam ( Layton Kyōju to Jōki no Shinsekai ) game :

The company also streamed a behind-the-scenes video for the game's theme song. Joe Hisaishi ( Studio Ghibli films) is composing the theme song "The New World" performed by Lilas.

The Professor Layton and the Curious Village game debuted for Nintendo DS in Japan in 2007 and the West in 2008. The game had ports for iOS, Android, and Panasonic 's DoCoMo P906i handset.

Professor Layton and The New World of Steam will launch on December 10 worldwide for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam . There is mouse support for all versions except Switch.

The game was previously slated for last year, but was delayed .

The game takes place after the events of Professor Layton and the Unwound Future , the franchise 's third Nintendo DS game. The setting is Steam Bison, America, where Luke has moved to and has invited Layton to visit. Yō Ōizumi returns to voice Layton, and Mio Imada is the new voice of Luke Triton.

The additional cast includes:

• Riho Yoshioka as Elinora and Elida

• Mahiro Takasugi as Eggmuffin

• Shin'ya Kote as Allinston

• Kōichi Yamadera as Sheriff Bobsley

• Akio Ōtsuka as Falcon

• Michaela Wako Sato as Mystella

Quiz Knock, a group specialized in creating puzzles and riddles for media, are in charge of the game's puzzles.

Layton's Mystery Journey: Katrielle and the Millionaire's Journey was the previous entry in the series. The game debuted in Japan for Nintendo 3DS and worldwide for iOS and Android devices in July 2017. The game then launched for Nintendo 3DS in the West in October 2017. The game launched for Switch in August 2018, and that version headed West in November 2019. The original game inspired the Layton Mystery Tanteisha: Katori no Nazotoki File television anime , which premiered in April 2018, and ended in March 2019.

Source : Level 5 Vision 2026 livestream
